collections.name: Repossessed Property
collections.title: NOTICE OF REPOSSESSION
collections.notice: These premises and their contents have been repossessed on behalf of the creditor. Collection agents are active inside. Entry will be treated as consent to collection. Behind the seal, through the glass of the door: a rack of seized goods, and a light that has not stopped blinking in three hundred years.
collections.opened: The seal breaks. Somewhere inside, a collections alarm starts to count.
collections.need: the seal broken at the notice beside it
collections.note: A scavenger's last entry, scratched into a pay slip: 'Vault behind here is full of what they took back. Got in fine. The big one doesn't stop and the alarm keeps calling more. Grab and go. Don't stay.'
collections.enter: The door seals behind you. COLLECTION IN PROGRESS.
collections.clear: The Liquidator falls. The alarm winds down, and the seals let go.

maker.say: The collections alarm sounds. Another agent is on its way.

extra.say: A dispenser clunks. Something small and quick is let out to collect.

overgrowth.name: Quarantine
overgrowth.title: QUARANTINE
overgrowth.notice: Containment breach. This section is sealed by order of the facility director. Do not enter. Do not open. Do not listen at the door. Through the glass: green light, something growing over everything, and on a slab at the far end, a strongbox nobody came back for.
overgrowth.opened: The seal hisses open. Spores drift out past you. Something in the dark has heard.
overgrowth.need: the quarantine seal broken at the notice beside it
overgrowth.note: Written on the inside of a helmet: 'it isn't a fungus. it isn't one thing. it's a nest. the mother is at the back. kill the little ones first or you never get to her.'
overgrowth.enter: The quarantine door slams behind you.
overgrowth.clear: The Brood Matron dies. The nest goes quiet, and the quarantine seals let go.

maker.say: The nest heaves. Something new crawls out of it.
